Ratpack errors can lose exception reporting when controller telemetry is disabled. This registers a dedicated request-scoped error context even when no handler span starts, independently of the signal-selection changes in #20648.

- **Context ownership:** Preserve handler-span error targets when enabled, while keeping error reporting separate from HTTP client parenting. Omit the current-context fallback: supported callbacks retain the request registry, while thread-current context may belong to another request.
- **Coverage:** Add disabled-controller JVM variants alongside existing enabled suites, covering synchronous, blocking, overlapping async, and forked errors, including request attribution, route naming, callback parentage, and outbound client parenting under an application span.
metadata.title: Fix Ratpack error reporting when no handler span starts
